events.title: Ranger News: Danger Levels and More Challenges
events.summary: In the latest Plush Rangers Demo update, we have added 2 big pieces of content along with a bunch of bug fixes and UI improvements.In the Echo out rescuing Junior Rangers!Danger LevelsDanger levels introduce new enemies and increases their stats making them more dangerous. To help balance, you get an XP boost to help scale you up. It's likely we will need to adjust the balance of some of this over time, but this is a starting place and it adds a lot of challenge to the game in the higher levels.

events.title: Big August Demo Update
events.summary: The Plush Rangers Demo has just received a big update changing the gameplay significantly. The updates introduce more structure to leveling up both the player and the enemies that are set to challenge you. Plushies Power Up FasterWe moved away from random level-ups to a structured format. This means that the first level up for each Plushie will be the same each time you play. events.summary: Bigger Demo for Bullet Fest!Hey everyone, Quick update - To celebrate the Bullet Fest mayhem going on now, the Plush Rangers demo has been updated with additional Plushies, Items, and a sneak peak at the Sparklands environment!We've also fixed a couple of issues based on feedback. Thank you!-Trevor and the Short Leg Studio team

events.title: Plush Rangers Demo and Roadmap
events.summary: Hi everyone, Demo is live!First off, we are excited to release the Plush Rangers demo ahead of Bullet Fest kicking off on June 8th. The demo features the first level and some of the content we are planning for the game. We will be continuing to update the demo with additional content, balance, and mechanics as those are completed in the final product.
